LIVE from Joy Bangla Concert 2018 at Army Stadium in Dhaka, the annual rock music initiative of Young Bangla , marking the anniversary of the historic March 7 speech by Bangabandhu Sheikh Mujibur Rahman that sparked our War of Liberation in 1971.
